rules.statement: Failure to comply with section 8 of the Mortgage Act, which requires a Proctor to file a declaration regarding registration of lis pendens before issuing summons in a hypothecary action, renders the subsequent hypothecary decree and sale null and void.
rules.supporting_quote: "In a hypothecary action, the failure of a Proctor to tile, before the issue of summons, the declaration required by section 8 of the Mortgage Act regarding registration of lis pendens, etc., renders null and void (and not merely voidable) the hypothecary decree ultimately entered and the sale in execution of it."
